categories.description: 價單 PRICE LIST — a unit catalogue: a table of units offered for sale with tower, floor, flat, saleable area, list price and price per square foot, plus payment plan and discount terms. Often titled 'PRICE LIST' or 'REVISED PRICE LIST'.

銷售安排 SALES ARRANGEMENT — a notice stating which units are offered for sale on a specific sale date, with sales method (ballot / first-come-first-served), time and venue. Mostly prose plus a list of unit references. Often titled 'SALES ARRANGEMENT'.

成交紀錄冊 REGISTER OF TRANSACTIONS — a chronological table of signed preliminary sale agreements (PASP): unit, date of PASP, transaction price, purchaser type, and remarks such as termination. Often titled 'REGISTER OF TRANSACTIONS'.

nodes.name: Classify Document
nodes.notes: Text Classifier routes each document to exactly one of three extractors. Category descriptions ARE the prompt — keep them precise.

parameters.text: ={{ 'CONTEXT: You are an SRPE document extractor for a property development analyst team. The document is a PRICE LIST (價單): a table of units offered for sale. Extract EVERY unit row. Per unit: tower (e.g. T1), floor (e.g. 5, ignore the F suffix), flat (e.g. A), saleable_area_sqft, list_price (HKD, plain number), list_price_per_sqft. Document-level: development (project code if given, else the development name), development_name (full name EN + 中文), price_list_no (e.g. \'1\' or \'3R\'), price_list_date (YYYY-MM-DD), currency (usually HKD), payment_plan (from the payment plans section, e.g. \'120-Day Payment Plan\' or \'Mortgage Payment Plan\'). Rules: unit_key format is TOWER-FLOORF-FLAT e.g. \'T1-5F-A\'; dates as YYYY-MM-DD; prices as plain numbers without commas or currency symbols; missing values → null; do NOT invent units. Output ONLY valid JSON matching the schema. If the document text is only a portion (PART x of y), extract EVERY unit present in this portion and nothing more.\n=== DOCUMENT TEXT (PART ' + (($json.chunk_index ?? 0) + 1) + ' OF ' + ($json.chunk_total ?? 1) + ') ===\n' + ($json.text || '') }}

={{ 'CONTEXT: You are an SRPE document extractor for a property development analyst team. The document is a SALES ARRANGEMENT (銷售安排): a notice of which units go on sale on a specific date. Extract document-level fields: development (project code if given, else the development name), development_name (full name EN + 中文), sale_date (YYYY-MM-DD), sales_method (e.g. \'Ballot 抽籤\' or \'First-come-first-served 先到先得\'), venue, sale_time (e.g. \'10:00 a.m.\'), and the list of units offered for sale (tower/floor/flat per unit). Rules: unit_key format is TOWER-FLOORF-FLAT e.g. \'T1-5F-A\'; dates as YYYY-MM-DD; missing values → null; do NOT invent units. Output ONLY valid JSON matching the schema.\n=== DOCUMENT TEXT ===\n' + ($json.text || $('Read PDF').item.json.text || '') }}

={{ 'CONTEXT: You are an SRPE document extractor for a property development analyst team. The document is a REGISTER OF TRANSACTIONS (成交紀錄冊): a chronological table of signed preliminary agreements. Extract EVERY transaction row: date (YYYY-MM-DD), tower, floor, flat, price (plain number), price_per_sqft, saleable_area_sqft, purchaser_type (e.g. \'Individual 個人買家\' or \'Local Company 本地公司\'), remarks. If remarks indicate a cancelled PASP (\'TERMINATED\', \'已取消\', \'撻訂\'), set terminated=true. Rules: unit_key format is TOWER-FLOORF-FLAT e.g. \'T1-5F-A\'; prices as plain numbers without commas or currency symbols; missing values → null; do NOT invent rows. Output ONLY valid JSON matching the schema.\n=== DOCUMENT TEXT ===\n' + ($json.text || $('Read PDF').item.json.text || '') }}

nodes.name: Gemini Chat Model - Classify & Extract
nodes.notes: ONE shared model sub-node feeds the classifier and all three extractors (ai_languageModel). Credential baked in: FA-03's '[JJ Paid] Gemini' (id vopaH2LdgdwdL832 — the same one the live FA-03 workflow uses). Swap the model from the dropdown if this preview model is unavailable.

nodes.name: Match & Validate
nodes.notes: Code #1 — deterministic, zero LLM cost: development matching vs watchlist (names + aliases), confidence gates (<0.7 -> REVIEW), unit_key normalisation, per-document duplicate rows.

nodes.name: Reconcile Unit Records
nodes.notes: Code #2 — 'Run Once for All Items'. The Business Plan's 'human judgement -> rule based' demand, in code: sold/terminated > selling > offered; duplicate detection; revised price list wins; unlisted units flagged. Outputs unit_records + review queue + stats.

nodes.name: Save to unit_records Table
nodes.notes: n8n Data Table — the shared unit_records table REA-02 also reads. Schema verified against n8n source (DataTable v1): resource 'row', operation 'insert', dataTableId RL, columns.mappingMode 'autoMapInputData' (= Map Automatically). continueOnFail keeps the demo pipeline alive if the table is missing.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Report
nodes.notes: Code #3 — deterministic HTML report (Chart.js CDN). Numbers come from the reconciled table, not from a language model: zero hallucination risk on management figures.

parameters.content:
## PD-02 Weekly SRPE Sales Reporting (v1.0)
POST `pd02/intake` (multipart upload, answers 202) -> per-file loop:
File Type Router -> Read PDF -> Text Quality Gate -> Text Classifier
-> 3 x Information Extractor (one shared Gemini model) -> Match & Validate
After the loop: Reconcile (funnel rule) -> unit_records Data Table -> Weekly Report HTML
Read endpoints: GET `pd02/batch-status`, `pd02/units`, `pd02/report`.
Spec: 01_Docs/PD-02 Weekly SRPE Sales Reporting — FDE Demo Design Spec.md

## Frontend request contract
Upload: `multipart/form-data` with `batch_id` + one or more PDFs to POST `pd02/intake`.
Poll: GET `pd02/batch-status?batch_id=` every 2.5s (status: processing -> complete).
Data: GET `pd02/units?batch_id=` -> {units, review_queue, stats}.
Report: GET `pd02/report?batch_id=` -> text/html (render in an iframe).
Do not rename the paths unless the frontend config.js is updated too.

## unit_records Data Table
Create the table once (n8n Data Tables, name: `unit_records`) and select it in `Save to unit_records Table`. Rows = one per unit (current state). REA-02 reads the same table. continueOnFail is ON — a missing table must never break the demo report.

## Demo storage only
Batches live in workflow static data (24h / 50 batches GC). Use the PRODUCTION webhook URLs when demoing (activate the workflow first). Production hardening: auth + access gateway, real DB instead of static data, object storage for originals, CORS restricted to the Pages origin.
